goal: Cubism native fidelity + multi-view artwork + 3D anchors + VDD + HTML offline visual acceptance

scope.engine: Three.js WebGL2 + Live2D Cubism Web SDK
scope.spatialYawSemantics: 0 front;90 character right;180 back;270 character left;360 front loop

verificationPrinciple: Native Cubism first. Only independent original art may establish truth for side and back views; renderer-generated pictures are diagnostic only.

tasks.name: source_and_sdk_lock
acceptance: Freeze model commit and enumerate all references
Verify actual downloaded asset hashes and SDK Core license/version
Real moc3 load preflight

tasks.name: native_cubism_html
acceptance: Native model and texture load
Idle/diantou/yaotou + 2 expressions + blink/mouth witnessed visually
Playback deterministic and screenshots from real canvas

tasks.name: native_drawable_capture
acceptance: Enumerate drawable mesh UV indices and texture IDs
Record clipping/render order/opacities including dynamics
Freeze and replay two motion sample timestamps

tasks.name: cubism_threejs_fidelity
acceptance: Same pose frame and camera for two implementations
Record per-pixel/alpha/coverage diffs including blended masks
Known UV/order/mask faults detected by tests and reviewer

tasks.name: view_source_registration
acceptance: Record true independent 0/45/90 art status and 20/55/82 heldouts
Source key and heldout provenance/source hashes
Missing side/back parts explicitly measured and assigned creation cost

tasks.name: vdd_and_anchor_integration
acceptance: Stable part identity across views
View-specific anchors/masks/depth tested in actual WebGL
VDD uses registered anatomy and topology states

tasks.name: head_90_visual_acceptance
acceptance: 0/15/30/45/60/75/90 real frame screenshots and independent holdout review
No unacceptable ear/hair/eye/nose/mouth seams
Engineering and independent visual review both pass

tasks.name: head_360_visual_acceptance
acceptance: Independent side and back view artwork exists and is registered
0/90/180/270/360 validated; 0 and 360 same pose
Continuous 360 yaw sweep and true backside accepted visually

tasks.name: motion_expression_view_crossproduct
acceptance: Blend selected motions/expressions/mouth/eye with viewpoint
Crossproduct screenshot matrix and temporal QA
Occlusion and identity stable throughout time

tasks.name: html_offline_package_acceptance
acceptance: Chrome offline assets loaded without network
True user operations: slider/buttons/play/pause/pass/export
Desktop 1366x900 and mobile 390x844 screenshot acceptance
All output frames from identical renderer clock

tasks.name: engine_promotion
acceptance: Portable engine code only in tims-SP/koma-motion
Source-agnostic regression fixtures and test scripts
Traceability from evidence and source SHA to promoted code

gates.completion: All tasks checked; C01/C03/C06/C07/C08/C09 must reach VISUAL_PASS with real screenshot and reviewer signoff

storage.git: Code, docs, manifests, synthetic fixtures, text-only QA
storage.private: R1999 asset bytes, screenshots/videos and HTML bundles containing artwork, proprietary Cubism Core
storage.legal: Reproduction or distribution permissions must be reviewed before public artifacts
